backend/main.mo: Motoko actor storing golf events and computing Callaway results, with event submission, update, and sorted result generation.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping app features to source files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries of many frontend source files for reference.
frontend/DRAFT_RESTORED.md: Notes marking restoration of a development draft without functional changes.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based stylesheet defining light/dark color tokens and base styling rules.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file loading the React app entrypoint.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app managing multi-step setup, score entry, Callaway calculation, leaderboard display, and admin access routing.
frontend/src/features/admin/AdminView.ts: Admin panel component gating access based on settings and exposing the Callaway chart editor.
frontend/src/features/admin/CallawayChar: Interactive editor for 9- and 18‑hole Callaway grid charts, supporting cell edits, validation, and saving/resetting chart data.
frontend/src/features/eventSetup/EventSe: Form for entering event metadata including title, course info, golfer count, hole count, and par, with input validation before submission.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Breakd: Displays a single player's Callaway scoring breakdown including gross, deductions, adjustments, and net score explanation.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Callaw: Renders the Callaway scoring chart for the selected hole count along with a brief explanation of how the system works.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/export: Creates a print-friendly HTML window and triggers browser printing to export tournament standings as a PDF.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Leader: Shows ranked player results with net, gross, deduction, and adjustment values, handling tie ranks and medal icons.
Full leaderboard view combining titles, standings table, score breakdown panels, and PDF export of final results.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/GolferS: Renders a list of golfer score entry cards with editable names and hole scores, updating parent state on changes.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/validat: Validates golfer data by checking name, expected hole count, and ensuring each score is present and within allowed limits.
frontend/src/features/settings/SettingsV: Displays application settings including a toggle for admin access and a back button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the current identity and invalidates dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, handling login, logout, and persisted identity loading.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks that call backend actor methods, including fetching the latest result.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind styles and theme variables for light and dark modes with a golf-themed palette.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/callaway.ts: Computes Callaway handicaps and net scores using active chart data, applying deduction rules and par-based exceptions.
Defines Callaway scoring chart structures, default 9- and 18‑hole charts, and a function to find the matching entry for a gross score.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/callawayChartP: Handles loading, saving, and resetting edited Callaway charts and grid data in localStorage with default grid generators.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, setting up React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering App.
frontend/src/state/adminAccess.ts: Manages a localStorage-backed flag controlling whether admin features are enabled.
frontend/src/state/eventTypes.ts: Declares TypeScript interfaces for event setup, golfer input, and Callaway scoring results.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS theme extensions, colors, animations, and plugins for the frontend.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, feature states, and pending requests for the Callaway scoring app.
